versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00211, SRS_Rte_00213, SRS_Rte_00216, SRS_BSW_00447 The RTE generator shall include the header file defined in the functionProto- typeEmitter of a BswCalledEntity s implementedEntry , if the value of the at- tribute functionPrototypeEmitter ends with " .h " and the RTE has to call the BswCalledEntity .
